findings.explanation: The SPL flags every single reading outside 40 to 60%, with no consecutive-poll logic.
findings.quote: Alert when RH stays outside 40–60% for longer than three consecutive polls
findings.suggested_fix: Either add a consecutive-poll check to the SPL, or describe the alert as firing on any single reading outside the band.

findings.explanation: The 40 to 60% RH band is not tied to a source. Current ASHRAE TC 9.9 recommended envelopes are expressed mainly as dew point with an upper RH cap. Check which edition the band comes from.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite the ASHRAE edition and envelope, or move the band to a site-policy lookup.

findings.explanation: The SPL has no aggregation, no `entity` field and no count.
findings.suggested_fix: Describe one row per humidity reading outside 40-60% with its zone.

findings.explanation: This is a device category, not an add-on. dataSources names SNMP Modular Input (1537) or Splunk Connect for SNMP (6266).
Check whether either add-on produces `sourcetype=sensor:humidity` with `humidity_pct` and `zone`; this normally needs props/transforms or a rename step that is not described.
findings.quote: commonly SNMP Modular Input (Splunkbase app 1537) or Splunk Connect for SNMP (Splunkbase app 6266)
findings.suggested_fix: Document the sourcetype and field mapping the chosen collector needs.

findings.explanation: SNMP polls are normally stamped with poll time. Check whether the probe exposes a usable timestamp, and whether SNMP read-only strings are granted to a `splunkfwd` account as the prerequisites say, since they are configured on the device and in the input.
findings.quote: translate timeticks into _time using the appliance clock
findings.suggested_fix: State that _time is the poll time unless the probe provides its own timestamp, and describe where the SNMP community or credentials live.

findings.explanation: A generic forwarding page does not help with SNMP humidity probes, and no ASHRAE source supports the thresholds.
findings.quote: Splunk Docs — Forward data to Splunk
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with the SNMP collector documentation and the ASHRAE reference.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: UC-15.2.10 is 'Humidity Threshold Exceedance (ASHRAE)' on a sibling sourcetype, so the two UCs overlap. Check for duplication.

summary: More specific than its siblings, but the implementation requires three consecutive out-of-band polls that the SPL does not implement. The 40-60% RH policy band is presented without an ASHRAE edition.
